description: Language-neutral design corpus for the pure in-memory definition and workflow compiler.

stage0Mappings.observation: accepted only when lookup returns one workflow, validation appends no error strings, and scope validation does not raise CompilationFailure
exact returned phase-ID array after an accepted workflow verdict

generators.algorithm: For boundary n, emit n ArtifactDescriptor definitions using the committed artifact-descriptor-example bytes, kind artifact-descriptor, and logical IDs definition-000 through definition-(n-1) as zero-padded three decimal digits; request missing-workflow.

Emit four unknown-kind definitions aggregate-0..aggregate-3. For maximum, each retained byte sequence is exactly 2,000,000 ASCII zero bytes. For maximum-plus-one, the first three are 2,000,000 bytes and the fourth is 2,000,001 bytes. Request missing-workflow.
Emit the committed artifact-descriptor-example as one artifact-descriptor definition whose logical ID is exactly n lowercase ASCII a characters; request missing-workflow.

Generate one catalog with n capabilities capability-0000.. in ascending zero-padded four decimal order, description Generated capability., usages [agent], effect read, policyCapability read-repository. Pair it with capability-limit-workflow, whose sole agent phase requests missing-capability.

Generate workflow-input-limit-workflow with n request inputs input-0000.. in ascending zero-padded four decimal order, each referencing factory-objective; one human accept phase and terminal ghost-phase.
Generate phase-limit-workflow with n independent human phases phase-00.. in ascending zero-padded two decimal order, no gates; acceptance [ghost-gate] and terminal ghost-phase.

Generate phase-input-limit-workflow with one request input objective and one human accept phase containing n bindings input-00.. in ascending zero-padded two decimal order, all sourced from objective; one required accepted gate and terminal ghost-phase.
Generate gate-limit-workflow with one human accept phase containing n schema gates gate-00.. in ascending zero-padded two decimal order, all non-required; acceptance contains gate-00.

Generate 16 human phases p000..p015. Add the 15 chain edges p(i-1)->p(i), then add earlier-source/later-target pairs in ascending target then source order, excluding chain duplicates, until n edges. No gates; acceptance [ghost-gate], terminal ghost-phase.

Generate 8 phases p000..p007 and exactly 22 dependency edges using dependency-edge-count order. p000 is an agent requesting missing-capability and has 20 objective bindings i00..i19; the rest are human. p007 has 16 required schema gates g00..g15 and acceptance contains all in ordinal order. p001 and p002 each have one valid self-target output-invalid correction. Pair one unrelated generated capability catalog. The exact formula is 2 definitions + 1 capability + 1 workflow input + 8 phases + (4 * 20 phase inputs) + (4 * 16 gates) + (3 * 22 edges) + 2 corrections + (2 * 16 acceptance IDs) = 256. Maximum-plus-one adds the same correction to p003, measuring 257.
